Set up environment
```{r setup, include=FALSE}

set.seed(123) #For reproducibility
```

Input files
```{r}
counts.norm = read.csv("~/Downloads/salmon.merged.gene_tpm.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = 1)
counts.norm$gene_name = NULL
counts.norm = convert_ensembl_symbol(counts.norm)
deconv = compute.deconvolution(counts.norm, normalized = F, methods = "Epidish", file_name = "IMMUCAN")
```
